text.description_html:
Door Closer Drop Plate

Use on doors with narrow top door frames and doors with glass, when the glass interferes with closer mounting. Often used on metal framed glass store front doors. Also used to lower a door closer.

For use with Global Door Controls door closer models, Global TC411, Global TC412, Global TC511, Global TC512, PDQ 5501-BCPA, Hagar 5200, Yale 3300, Doromatic SC80, Dorma 8600, Norton 800 or any door closer with a common 12" x 3/4"  mounting hole pattern.

Specifications: for Global DP-1045 Drop Plate

  • Total Length: 13"
  • Total Height: 3-5/8"
  • Thickness: 1/8"
  • Material: Steel
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 12"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Packaged with installation screws

*Sold Individually.
